verdict.rationale: cubic documents several ways to operate it in natural language. In PR comments you can tag `@cubic-dev-ai` or reply to its comments to ask questions, trigger reviews and request fixes, and plain-language replies teach it rules for next time. Its official MCP server lets a coding agent request reviews, triage issues, and even check the subscription and manage or buy seats from inside the MCP client. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the natural-language commands work as described; natural-language control of configuration, which appears to rely on cubic.yaml or the UI; and current (non-archived) documentation for the in-app AI chat.
